title: cmdpal: pin packaged apps by AUMID

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

No material correctness defect was established in the packaged-app identity change. Packaged command identities use the manifest AUMID independently of localized presentation; production enumeration excludes empty AUMIDs. Existing packaged pins intentionally require re-pinning, while unpackaged identity generation is unchanged. The reference-identity test concerns were optional future-proofing rather than current failures.

**Validation scope:** Provenance-checked CI build 391950 used the same tree: x64 and ARM64 Release builds succeeded, and the x64 Apps test assembly passed 87 tests with none failed or skipped. OS-language-switch end-to-end testing and deployment were not performed.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional approval.

actions.label: Post qualified assessment summary (no code changes requested)
